mapper.select: SELECT property_type AS propertyType, sgg_nm AS sggNm, bjdong_nm AS bjdongNm, area_sqm AS areaSqm, build_year AS buildYear, price_10k_won AS price10kWon, contract_date AS contractDate FROM trade WHERE cancel_date IS NULL AND share_type IS NULL AND contract_date >= #{recencyCutoff}
SELECT bjdong_nm AS bjdongNm, area_sqm AS areaSqm, price_10k_won AS price10kWon, contract_date AS contractDate FROM trade WHERE ORDER BY contract_date DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT to_char(contract_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_10k_won / area_sqm) AS medianPricePerSqm, COUNT(*) AS tradeCount FROM trade WHERE GROUP BY to_char(contract_date, 'YYYY-MM') HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY month
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE price_10k_won / area_sqm <= #{value}) / COUNT(*), 2) END FROM trade WHERE

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contract_date >= #{cutoff1y}) AS recent1yCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contract_date >= #{cutoff3y}) AS recent3yCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contract_date >= #{cutoff5y}) AS recent5yCount FROM trade WHERE AND contract_date >= #{cutoff5y}
